questions.q: What was Mr. Fogg doing while Passepartout was in the tavern with Fix?
choices: Searching the docks for a faster ship to Japan
Shopping with Aouda for things she needed for the voyage
Playing whist with some English officers at the Club Hotel all evening
Asking at the Exchange for news of Aouda's cousin
questions.evidence: making the necessary purchases for the long voyage before them

questions.q: How did Fogg explain his generosity to Aouda when she protested?
choices: He said it was a part of his programme
He said he was a very rich man
He said she could pay him back later
He said the club would pay for it
questions.evidence: It is in the interest of my journey--a part of my programme.

questions.q: Why wasn't Fogg worried when Passepartout did not come back at bedtime?
choices: He thought the ship sailed next morning
He thought Passepartout was looking after Aouda
He had sent Passepartout on an errand across the island
He guessed Passepartout had gone aboard to sleep
questions.evidence: knowing that the steamer was not to leave for Yokohama until the next morning

questions.q: What did Fogg say to Aouda when he learned the Carnatic had already sailed?
choices: "We are ruined, madam; the wager is lost."
"It is an accident, madam; nothing more."
"My servant has betrayed me, madam."
"We must wait here a week, madam."
questions.evidence: It is an accident, madam; nothing more.

questions.q: Why did Fix's heart "leap for joy" on the quay?
choices: He thought Fogg would be stuck in Hong Kong for a week, until the warrant came
He saw Passepartout running toward them along the wharf
He had found a letter from London waiting for him at the steamer office that morning
He believed Aouda would tell him where the money was hidden
questions.evidence: Fogg detained at Hong Kong for a week!

questions.q: What did Fogg do right after hearing they would have to wait a week?
choices: He went back to the hotel to read the newspapers
He went to the docks to look for another vessel
He sent a telegram to the Reform Club in London
He asked the police to search for Passepartout
questions.evidence: he directed his steps toward the docks in search of some craft about to start

questions.q: What did Fogg first offer the pilot to sail him to Yokohama?
choices: Fifty pounds and the price of a new sail
100 pounds a day, plus a 200-pound reward
A thousand pounds, paid in advance on the quay
A share of his winnings when he got back to London
questions.evidence: I offer you a hundred pounds per day

questions.q: How did Aouda answer when Fogg asked if she would be afraid of the voyage?
choices: "Not with you, Mr. Fogg."
"A little, but I will come."
"Only of the storms, sir."
"I would rather stay here."

questions.q: Why did the pilot's plan to sail to Shanghai work for Fogg?
choices: The San Francisco steamer actually started from Shanghai
Shanghai had a railway that went straight to Yokohama
The Carnatic was going to stop and wait at Shanghai for him to arrive
A faster steamer left Shanghai for London that week

questions.q: Fogg asks, "Would you like some earnest-money?" What is "earnest-money"?
choices: A deposit paid in advance
A tip for the crew after the trip
Money borrowed from a bank
A fine for breaking a promise

questions.q: What did Fogg do to try to find Passepartout before leaving?
choices: He searched every tavern near the quay himself
He gave his description and money to the police and the French consulate
He left a note at the hotel and nothing else
He hired a man to wait on the wharf with a sign
questions.evidence: Phileas Fogg there gave Passepartout's description

questions.q: How did Fix feel about accepting Fogg's offer of a place on the Tankadere?
choices: Proud that his plan had worked perfectly
Something like humiliation at using Fogg's kindness
Frightened of the long voyage in a small boat
Annoyed that the cabin he was given was so small, plain and crowded
questions.evidence: The detective had a feeling akin to humiliation in profiting by the kindness of Mr. Fogg.

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: Passepartout waking up in the tavern and racing to the Carnatic
Fogg missing the Carnatic and hiring a small pilot-boat instead
Fix finally getting the warrant and arresting Fogg in Hong Kong
Aouda deciding to stay behind and wait for Passepartout
questions.evidence: pilot-boat No. 43, with its crew on board
